events.title: Holiday Lighting on the Plaza
events.blurb: Hot chocolate, cookies, food trucks and live music start at 4:30 p.m., Mr. and Mrs. Claus arrive on a vintage fire truck, and the Mayor switches on about 30,000 LED lights at 6:15 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Chocolate caliente, galletas, food trucks y música en vivo desde las 4:30 p.m.; Santa y la Sra. Claus llegan en un camión de bomberos antiguo y el alcalde enciende unas 30,000 luces LED a las 6:15 p.m.

events.title: Company
events.addr: 142 E De Vargas St, Santa Fe, NM 87501
events.blurb: Sondheim's musical about Bobby's 35th birthday and the friends and couples who weigh in on why he's still single. Runs 2 hours 30 minutes with intermission, through Dec 20.
events.blurbEs: El musical de Sondheim sobre el cumpleaños 35 de Bobby y los amigos y parejas que opinan sobre por qué sigue soltero. Dura 2 horas y 30 minutos con intermedio; en cartelera hasta el 20 de diciembre.

events.title: SWAIA Winter Indian Market
events.addr: 201 W Marcy St, Santa Fe, NM 87501
events.blurb: About 160 juried artists from the 2026 Santa Fe Indian Market sell jewelry, pottery, textiles, paintings and sculpture. $15 day pass or $25 weekend pass.
events.blurbEs: Unos 160 artistas seleccionados del Santa Fe Indian Market 2026 venden joyería, cerámica, textiles, pinturas y esculturas. Pase de un día $15 o de fin de semana $25.

events.title: 7th Annual Holiday Art Market
events.venue: Wheelwright Museum of the American Indian
events.blurb: The museum's Case Trading Post hosts its annual market where you can buy directly from Indigenous artists. Museum admission is free that day.
events.blurbEs: El Case Trading Post del museo organiza su mercado anual para comprar directamente a artistas indígenas. La entrada al museo es gratis ese día.

events.title: Canyon Road galleries
events.blurb: About 100 galleries along a half-mile adobe lane.
events.blurbEs: Unas 100 galerías a lo largo de una calle de adobe de 800 metros.
